title: macOS Satellites
summary: Amp explains a split workflow that keeps the agent, backend, and editing on Linux while attaching a fresh cloud Mac for Xcode builds and Simulator checks, illustrated with an iPhone Duo layout adaptation. An iOS team can return screenshots, logs, and a recording to the task before accepting a change; the beta reuses a Mac briefly, then deletes its state.
takeaway: Keep native verification on a Mac while sharing the backend from Linux, and return build logs and interaction evidence before the temporary Mac is deleted.
